arts.ttl: Frank ahead of PSG clash: '1,000% sure' I can build a team at Spurs
arts.sum: Thomas Frank is "1,000% sure" he can build a team at Tottenham and promised to learn from this bad spell as he prepares for an ominous meeting with Paris Saint-Germain.

arts.ttl: Thomas Frank insists he will 'build the club' at Tottenham despite pain of Arsenal hammering ahead of daunting PSG clash
arts.sum: Thomas Frank promised Tottenham fans he knows what he is doing, and that he can build a team in the style they demand despite faltering form and the pain of a four-goal hammering at Arsenal.

arts.ttl: PSG vs. Tottenham: Champions League revenge for Thomas Frank's team?
arts.sum: Tottenham, shrouded in darkness after their north London derby defeat, head to the City of Light for a Champions League meeting with Paris Saint-Germain.

arts.ttl: Ousmane Dembélé included in the PSG squad to face Tottenham

arts.ttl: “He has the level, but it’s difficult” – Luis Enrique on Tottenham player’s struggles this season
arts.sum: Tottenham Hotspur striker Randal Kolo Muani has received the backing of Paris Saint-Germain boss Luis Enrique, despite his struggles at Spurs. Le 10 Sport cover comments from the PSG boss today. He was asked about his former striker, who joined Tottenham on loan from PSG in the summer. arts.ttl: Dembélé set for PSG UCL return against Spurs
arts.sum: Ousmane Dembélé could return for Paris St Germain in Wednesday's Champions League home fixture with Tottenham.

arts.ttl: PSG vs Tottenham – Paris lineup confirmed with Mayulu
arts.sum: This Wednesday, Paris Saint-Germain (5th) faces Tottenham (10th) at the Parc des Princes for Matchday 5 of the 2025-2026 Champions League (kick-off at 9 pm, CET). arts.ttl: PSG coach hopeful Ousmane Dembélé will return for PSG’s Champions League clash against Tottenham
arts.sum: Ousmane Dembélé trained with his PSG teammates on Tuesday and could make his return from injury for the Champions League match against Tottenham this week. PSG coach Luis Enrique said on the eve of the match against Spurs at the Parc des Princes that Dembélé would be included in the squad “if there is no problem.”

arts.ttl: Luis Enrique wants PSG 'dominant' vs. Tottenham
arts.sum: Paris Saint-Germain manager Luis Enrique said he is seeking a "more dominant" team performance for Wednesday's Champions League clash against Tottenham Hotspur.

arts.ttl: PSG vs Tottenham – Many English fans expected at the Parc des Princes
